name: Italian law: the Constitution, every legge costituzionale, L. 300/1970, L. 241/1990, D.Lgs. 196/2003 and D.Lgs. 82/2005, from Normattiva's multivigente text

dates.time: 12:00 Europe/Rome (UTC+1, UTC+2 in summer time); in force before 1970: 1970-01-01T00:00Z plus one second per commit, real day in In-force

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: a law provides only for the future and has no retroactive effect, unless it says otherwise (the rule binds ordinary interpretation, not the legislator, except in criminal law, where no one may be punished under a law that was not in force when the act was committed)
default_reach.authority: Disposizioni sulla legge in generale, art. 11 ("La legge non dispone che per l'avvenire: essa non ha effetto retroattivo."); Costituzione, art. 25, secondo comma ("Nessuno può essere punito se non in forza di una legge che sia entrata in vigore prima del fatto commesso.")
